example.story:
Once upon a time there was a little boy named Quinn. Quinn loved to explore the world around him. He saw many amazing things, like beautiful vases that were on display in a store. One day, Quinn was walking through the store when he came across a very special vase. When Quinn saw it he was amazed! He said, “Wow, that is a really amazing vase! Can I buy it?” 
The shopkeeper smiled and said, “Of course you can. You can take it home and show all your friends how amazing it is!”
So Quinn took the vase home and he was so proud of it! He called his friends over and showed them the amazing vase. All his friends thought the vase was beautiful and couldn't believe how lucky Quinn was. And then the lights went out, and nobody ever saw them again.
